claims.text: Venetoclax + azacitidine, decitabine or ↓dose cytarabine: newly dx AML, age ≥ 75 or comorbidities precluding intensive induction.
claims.quote: is used in combination with azacitidine, decitabine, or low-dose cytarabine for the treatment of newly diagnosed AML in adults who are ≥ 75 years or who have comorbidities that preclude use of intensive induction chemotherapy
